notes.subject: בשלש
notes.rationale: 'ka tharo' (a triple measure) — the Hebrew leaves the instrument unnamed; KJV 'in a measure', BSB 'in a basket'

notes.subject: וכל
notes.rationale: lemma כלל 'to measure/comprehend' — KJV 'comprehended' vs BSB 'held'; Sesotho 'a boka' (gathered in)

notes.subject: isaiah 40:12
notes.rationale: the whole verse is a chain of measuring acts — waters, heavens, dust, mountains, hills — rhetorically unanswerable questions

notes.subject: rhetorical questions
notes.rationale: five 'who?' questions draw the hearer to admit that no one but Yahwe measures creation

translation: Ke mang ya lekanyetsang metsi ka sefubjeng sa letswele la hae, mme o lekanya mahodimo ka phapanyetsano, mme a boka ⟨⟨את⟩⟩ mongobo wa lefatshe ka tharo, mme a bata lithaba ka sekala, le dithabana ka mekaleng?
